title: Second Story Over The Garage
summary: A full second story framed over an existing attached two-car garage, with the main roofline carried across the whole elevation and siding, trim, and shutters matched to the original house. The foundation and footprint are unchanged.

cover.alt: Two-story colonial home after Blue Rock built a second story over the attached garage, with the roofline carried across the full width and siding, trim, and shutters matched to the original house
cover.caption: Finished Elevation

title: White Marble Primary Bath
summary: A bright primary suite in white and marble - a light oak double vanity with marble counters, brass fixtures, and a freestanding tub set beneath a triple window under a skylight. Built out of a full gut: the bath was taken back to the studs for new plumbing and electrical, a new subfloor and a curbed shower base in cement board, then Ditra underlayment for the large-format marble floor tile.

cover.alt: White primary bathroom with light oak vanity, marble counters, brass fixtures, and a freestanding tub under a triple window

title: Primary Bath Gut Renovation
summary: A primary suite bath taken back to the frame and rebuilt - a marble-look walk-in shower behind a black barn-slider door, a freestanding soaking tub under the window, and a white chevron-panel double vanity with backlit mirrors, all in matte black. The hall bath was rebuilt in the same materials.

cover.alt: Finished primary bathroom with a marble-look walk-in shower behind a black barn-slider glass door, a freestanding soaking tub under the window, and a matte black floor-mounted tub filler

title: Underground Tornado Shelter
summary: A private storm shelter built below grade off the lower level - a poured concrete room under a steel deck ceiling behind a gasketed vault door, joined to a barrel-vaulted concrete tunnel that runs out to a ladder and a steel escape hatch set flush into the patio. Two ways out, independent of the house.

cover.alt: Diamond-plate steel escape hatch standing open in a concrete patio pad beside the deck stairs, with the lawn and trees of the back yard behind it

title: Two-Bay Garage Rebuild
summary: A two-bay garage in Potomac taken back to studs and rebuilt as finished space. The temporary shoring came out for a steel beam carrying the floor above, the slab was waterproofed to a trench drain at the threshold and coated in flake epoxy, and the walls went back in full-height slatwall with built-in cabinetry and a wood workbench. Outside, the elevation was re-sided and re-trimmed under a gambrel roof, with new glass-panel doors hung in the original brick openings.

cover.alt: The finished two-bay garage from the driveway, both doors raised on the tan brick base to show the slatwall and epoxy floor inside, under a gray gambrel second story with a copper-capped bay window and a red Japanese maple alongside

title: Office to Full Bath Conversion
summary: A board-and-batten home office in Silver Spring converted into a full bathroom - taken back to the studs and the subfloor opened to run supply, waste, and vent lines into a room that had none, then finished with a fluted wood-look shower behind a brushed brass slider, a floating oak double vanity under arched mirrors, and marble-look porcelain underfoot. A second bath was rebuilt in the same trip in matching stone and brass.

cover.alt: The finished bathroom in the former office, with a fluted wood-look tile shower behind a brushed brass sliding glass door, a brass shower set, and the original corner windows carried through to the new room

title: Wood-Tone Kitchen Modernized
summary: A dated golden oak kitchen rebuilt as a light gray shaker kitchen on the same footprint - raised-panel oak and speckled granite out, dove-gray cabinetry carried to the ceiling with glass-front display uppers in, under marble-look quartz counters and a full-height slab backsplash. A dark-stained island with a microwave drawer replaced the oak-panelled one, the fluorescent ceiling panel gave way to recessed cans and nickel chandeliers, and the appliances went to a Wolf dual range, a built-in Sub-Zero, and a stainless apron-front sink. The original red oak floors stayed.

cover.alt: The finished kitchen seen down the length of the white quartz island, with dove-gray shaker cabinetry carried to the ceiling, a marble-look slab backsplash behind the Wolf range, a built-in Sub-Zero at left, and the original red oak floors

title: Bethesda Home Addition
summary: A home addition in Bethesda, framed over the existing footprint. Photographs of the completed work are being prepared.

cover.alt: The Bethesda house after Blue Rock built a second story over the garage wing, with an angled mid-century roofline, full-height glazing, tan panel cladding, and teal accent panels matching the original entry band

title: Navy Island Kitchen & Family Room
summary: A kitchen and family room rebuilt as one open floor, with a navy island running the length of the room under a white quartz top, white shaker cabinetry with aged-brass hardware, and a downdraft cooktop that keeps the sightline through to the family room clear. New white oak floors carry through both rooms, and the family room's brick fireplace was painted charcoal and given a reclaimed timber mantel.

cover.alt: The finished kitchen straight on across the navy island, three brass pendants over its white quartz top, five tan leather stools along the front, and white shaker cabinetry with the built-in refrigerator, stacked wall ovens, and gas cooktop against the marble-look slab backsplash behind

title: Primary Suite & Spa Shower
summary: A primary suite rebuilt as one run of rooms - a vaulted bedroom on new red oak floors opening through panelled doors into a bath built around an oversized walk-in shower, glazed end to end with two full shower sets, a floating marble bench, and a recessed niche. A freestanding soaking tub sits under the window beside it, with a stained oak double vanity, quartz counters, arched mirrors, and brushed brass fittings throughout.

cover.alt: The finished primary bath, a freestanding soaking tub under the window with a brushed nickel floor filler beside a glass-walled walk-in shower running the length of the wall, its marble-look slab walls, floating bench, recessed niche, and two shower sets over a mosaic floor

title: Rockville Primary Suite
summary: A primary suite in Rockville - the bedroom and its ensuite bath - taken back to the studs and rebuilt. Pink fixtures, twin pedestal sinks and dark-stained mirror surrounds gave way to a frameless glass shower lined in chevron-laid marble with a lit niche, a freestanding soaking tub, and a floating teak vanity with twin trough basins under a backlit mirror, all over a hex marble mosaic floor. The bedroom was reframed, rewired and refinished on new plank flooring.

cover.alt: The finished primary bath, a frameless glass shower lined in chevron-laid marble with a lit recessed niche, a freestanding soaking tub under the window, a recessed white storage cabinet, and a hex marble mosaic floor
